visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a sunny, outdoor historical site featuring the Great Sphinx of Giza in the foreground and a pyramid in the background. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the weathered texture of the ancient yellow limestone structures against a pale blue sky. No characters are visible in this opening shot. (2) A sharp cut transitions to an indoor studio with a flat gray background and bright studio lighting. A person is seen from the back, wearing a shiny, metallic gold long-sleeved top with gathered fabric. Their hair is styled in numerous small black braids, each adorned with metallic silver and gold beads that catch the light. The character slowly raises and moves their arms in a rhythmic, dance-like motion. (3) The visual shifts to a black and white graphic representation of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics and wall paintings, depicting figures in traditional garb and various symbolic elements. The lighting here is flat and monochromatic. (4) Back in the studio, the person in the gold metallic top continues their graceful arm movements from the back. White Chinese text overlays appear in the center of the frame. The setting remains the same minimalist gray studio wall. (5) Another graphic cut shows a series of ancient Egyptian cobra symbols, or uraeus, arranged in a row. This is presented as a high-contrast black and white still image. (6) Returning to the person in the studio, they maintain their rhythmic posing, with their hands held high above their head. More white Chinese text appears over the imagery. (7) The final phase transitions to a pure black screen. High-contrast white text displays a year and a phrase, followed by a specific date and another phrase in subsequent frames. No physical objects or characters are present.
